span.text: We performed intention-to-treat (ITT) analysis of data from 214 patients and per-protocol (PP) analysis of data from 172 patients.

notes: Selected the primary outcome AAD-1 in the ITT analysis; counts are patients, not episodes. Participants were adults receiving antibiotics for respiratory tract infection. Alternative ITT AAD-2 (loose or watery stools more than 2 times per day for at least 2 days) was 9 (8.7%) of 103 Lactobacillus patients and 16 (14.4%) of 111 placebo patients. PP AAD-1 was 3 (3.6%) of 83 Lactobacillus patients and 5 (5.6%) of 89 placebo patients. PP AAD-2 was printed as 8 (9.6%) of 103 Lactobacillus patients and 9 (10.1%) of 89 placebo patients; the printed Lactobacillus denominator is inconsistent with the PP AAD-1 denominator and is not corrected here. The full-text tables are image references whose image contents are NOT_IN_PACKET; the reported counts are explicitly stated in the prose.
